replacements.value: Hi Lee, I know you're busy — I'm not assuming anything about the silence, just checking in. I still need your decision by 16:00 today so I can move forward. If no or not yet is the answer, that's completely fine and I'll plan around it; I just need to know which. If you'd like, I can share the specific points that would help you decide quickly. Either way, thanks for taking a look when you can. — Your name
